summary: Full iteration-2 verification: 28 backend tests (100% pass) covering whatsapp-toggle, register/registered, event reminder-toggle, reminder-prefs, feedback, admin/feedback, complete-profile phone validation, saved flow regression, admin/event CRUD with empty external_link. Frontend tested via Playwright on Home, Saved, Profile Feedback, EventDetail, Calendar, Admin Feedback tab, CompleteProfile. All 8 iteration-2 changes verified working end-to-end with no critical issues.

minor.issue: Returns events using events collection's event_date rather than the snapshot event_date stored in registered_events. Not a functional bug for calendar (events rarely change date), but the stored event_date field on registered_events docs is essentially unused by GET /registered. Recommend either returning the snapshot event_date or dropping it from the doc.

action_items: Optional: harmonize /api/registered to return the snapshot event_date from registered_events collection (or remove unused field).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: seed_events() logger reference occurs before logger is defined (logger is defined at line ~573 while seed_events uses it at line ~552). Since it's only called on startup this happens after module load — currently works but is fragile; move logging.basicConfig / getLogger to top of file.

CalendarPage.jsx: overlap/amber highlight logic is present but never triggers in practice because /registered dedupes by event_id and returns each event with its actual event_date. Two events can only overlap if they legitimately share the same event_date in the events collection. Consider a small integration test seed with two real events sharing a date to validate visually.

EventCard/EventDetail: `external_link === ''` disables Register CTA with a tooltip — good UX; make sure any admin-added event without link also passes through same guard on all surfaces (verified on card + detail).
test_credentials: Admin: admin@clann.com / Clann@2026. User sessions seeded directly in Mongo per /app/auth_testing.md.
